title: The Latest Crier for Nov 05, 2026
items:
HYPNOTIST

You will come to the CAB event on Friday, November 6th at 8 PM in Douwstra … You will watch hypnotist Terry Stokes Jr .… You will bring your friends and have a great time… See you there! 🔮

Line Dance Night

We are excited to announce that Jara Johnson is partnering with CAB for Line Dance Night! Come to the Graham Conference Center on Sat. Nov. 7th from 7-10pm for a fun evening of line dancing! Jara will teach lessons from 7-8:30pm and open dance will be held from 8:30-10pm. See you there!
